notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4 released
notes.content: Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause passengers to prioritize Signs with different targets incorrectly.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3 released
notes.content: Fixed an issue that would prevent the game from getting past the initial loading screen on first launching.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 released
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue that would cause passengers to incorrectly choose between multiple Needs items of the same type. Having multiple Information Boards near each other should now properly split passengers.
[*] Updated Unity version to include any new fixes to the engine. This should help some players who have been experiencing issues.[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1 released
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue that would sometimes prevent saving when a Sign was recently destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent certain corners from being considered for navigation, leading to passengers occasionally getting stuck or taking odd paths.
[*] Fixed an issue relating to elevators that would sometimes prevent saving of custom maps or ongoing games.
[*] Fixed a buffer overflow issue that would cause errors in very large and complex stations.
[*] Some localization fixes.[/list]

Thanks to everyone reporting issues on the Discussion boards or directly! It helps us find and reproduce hard to trace bugs like these.

notes.title: STATIONflow is officially launched!
notes.content:
STATION[i]flow[/i] is now officially out of Early Access and fully launched!

[previewyoutube=a1A72yXQfw8;full][/previewyoutube]

We've collected a number of features into the release, with the goal of giving everyone a lot more variety in their gameplay, and a lot more to play with long-term. Have fun!

[list][*] [b]Map editing and sharing, Steam Workshop support[/b]
[list][*] Customize existing maps or create all new ones from scratch.
[*] Place and set train lines, exits and terrain obstacles.
[*] Share your maps through the Steam Workshop, or even directly as files.[/list]
[*] [b]5 new official maps added[/b]
[list][*] All new maps created fully with the new map editor.
[*] Of course, the Classic map is still available to play as well.
[*] And a bonus up on the Workshop...[/list]
[*] [b]Adjustable difficulty settings and sandbox mode[/b]
[list][*] Adjust construction time, cost, upkeep and passenger satisfaction: higher or lower, as you prefer.
[*] You can even set them to 0, allowing for partially or entirely sandbox play.
[*] Unlock the entire map and/or all progression from the start. This gives you a head start, but you also need to manage everything right from the beginning.
[*] Combine all of these for an overall difficulty rating, from "Easy" to "Very Hard".[/list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
30 achievements to unlock—and some of them are [i]hard[/i].

[*] [b]ついに日本語対応！[/b]
Japanese language support

[*] Performance improvements and bugfixes[/list]
[b]Save games note:[/b] Old save games from previous versions of the game may not load correctly in the new version. If you wish to keep playing them, you may switch back to an older version of the game by going to the game's Properties > Betas tab and selecting the desired version from the dropdown.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.14.2 released
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue that made users with certain OS Regional Format settins (i.e. Thai) unable to open the Save/Load games windows.
[*] Stairs, Escalators and Elevators now need more open floor space in front of them to ensure a good connection.[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.14.1 released
notes.content: Fixed a buffer overflow error that was happening in very large stations.

notes.title: Version 0.14.0 released!
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.14.0[/b] has been released!
[list][*]You can now use [b]Overlays[/b] to visualize the Satisfaction, Needs and other statuses of passengers. Use this to better analyze your station!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/95b658f7915f4152a77dc0d250aef12e7abc19de.png[/img]
[*]Similarly, you can also highlight passengers heading to a single exit or train line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/33da9703d0cfa8d577a20df603865bb6ae505d14.png[/img]
[*]Added a "Too small" error message for floor construction. Also made the minimum size slightly smaller, so you can better fill gaps.
[*]Quicksave and Autosave now make a backup of the old file before saving.[/list]
[b]Save games note:[/b] Old save games from previous versions of the game may not load correctly in the new version. If you wish to keep playing them, you may switch back to an older version of the game by going to the game's Properties > Betas tab and selecting the desired version from the dropdown.

[b]Localization note:[/b] Because we are doing translation to non-English languages in batch, a few lines of newly added or modified text have not been localized yet. These will show up in-game in English. We plan to have everything fully localized by launch.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.13.4 released
notes.content: Fixed a buffer overflow error that was happening in very large stations.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.13.3 released
notes.content: Fixed a navigation issue that occurred when a sign arrow was pointed at an opposite-facing escalator, causing the escalator to sometimes be ignored.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.13.2 released
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused certain save games to not load correctly.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.13.1 released
notes.content: A small fix addressing a player-reported navigation AI issue.

notes.title: Version 0.13.0 released!
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.13.0[/b] has been released! Here are all the new features and updates...
[list][*] Signs can now be set to indicate Elevators, Escalators and/or Stairs specifically. Passengers desiring these will prioritize these signs, while others may ignore them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/548f8fb1c63be4085b1c871b18e427d73c8c71e6.png[/img]
[*] Signs attached to Elevators, Escalators and Stairs now have icons to distinguish them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/35224f0d2bc5819a8184677f2682088cdbe760b6.png[/img]
[*] Added new buttons to copy and paste Sign settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/936dda403f4380f387d89a5c99b9d49302ea10d5.png[/img]
[*] You can now build Elevators with opposite facing ends: click the button during Plotting to change the setting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/df13d325ec62d965ee99258b7b498141906acf3b.png[/img]
[*] Slightly reduced overlapping for Train Platforms, so you can now build on the corners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36309210/da9ae023826d9b27c6ab0170f5e764494675a41e.png[/img]
[*] Added new setting "Passenger Model Variation": This allows you to reduce the number of models used for passengers to gain an increase in rendering performance.
[*] Increased passenger vision range across the board.
[*] Station Office now costs money to use.
[*] Various updates and fixes to navigation AI.
[*] Various visual improvements.[/list]
[b]Save games note:[/b] Old save games from previous versions of the game may not load correctly in the new version. If you wish to keep playing them, you may switch back to an older version of the game by going to the game's Properties > Betas tab and selecting the desired version from the dropdown.

[b]Localization note:[/b] Because we are doing translation to non-English languages in batch, a few lines of newly added or modified text have not been localized yet. These will show up in-game in English. We plan to have everything fully localized by launch.
